M0 NOTE: this is a deliberately TRIVIAL placeholder table — a uniform
quantum-spaced set of 8 classes covering [1, 128] B. The tuned, non-uniform
table that meets the full Section 9.4 spacing-ratio targets up to small_max =
32 KiB is emitted by the Lean model in plan 02 (W1-4e) at M1 and replaces this
golden then. Uniform 16 B spacing is the *minimum achievable* under a 16 B ABI
quantum, so every class here is alignment-optimal and provably sound.
